purpose: Freeze and qualify the incident-only geometric exit-token teacher before any GSE LiDAR export or model training.

approval.scope: One immutable CPU/Open3D audit over exactly the already approved 80 train and 10 validation parents. Zero C10, M-TARE, sensor export, model inference, training, optimizer or checkpoint selection.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly authorized continuous execution of the fixed GSE-Graph paper plan and requested no repeated approval prompts.

worlds.train_exact_set: For each schema S01_flat_tree_small, S02_3d_tree_small, S03_flat_unicyclic_small, S04_3d_unicyclic_small, S05_flat_branch_medium, S06_3d_branch_medium, S07_flat_loop_rich, S08_3d_loop_rich, S09_flat_complex and S10_3d_complex: variants C01 through C08, exactly as sealed in gse_teacher_manifest_v1.

teacher.source: Sealed TNG graph, directed spline, geometry parameters and native perception mesh.
teacher.candidate_rule: Junction/terminal observations use only physical edges incident to their selected objective node and orient each edge away from that node. Corridor/turn/geometry-transition observations retain both directed exits of only the current physical edge.
teacher.physical_identity_rule: Token identity is parent:edge:from->to. Different physical edges remain distinct even when they share one tunnel ID; nonincident and stacked tunnels are forbidden.
teacher.representative_geometry: At 2.5 m along the directed candidate route, native mesh cross-section supplies opening width; spline centerline supplies robot-relative heading and z changes at 2.5/5/7.5/10 m.
teacher.visibility: A native-mesh first-return ray from the current sealed sensor pose to the representative sensor pose must not hit more than 0.25 m before the target. Positive infinity means no occluder and is visible; NaN/negative returns are invalid.
teacher.missing_width: Insufficient mesh ray support masks only opening width. It never substitutes radius, deletes the candidate or changes its identity, heading, profile or LOS label.
teacher.node_failure: Any junction or terminal observation with zero visible incident candidates fails the formal audit.
teacher.student_input_exclusion: TNG identities, graph incidence, splines, mesh rays and future frames are teacher-only and never enter model input.

split_logic.train: Only the 80 sealed C01-C08 parents may later contribute gradient samples.
split_logic.validation: Only the ten sealed C09 parents may later calibrate temperature, rejection thresholds and checkpoint selection.
split_logic.strict_test: C10 remains unread until model and thresholds are frozen.

expected_evidence: 448338 candidate audit rows retaining observation, physical edge, orientation, width mask, vertical profile and LOS result.
Ninety per-world summaries and exact train/validation event distributions.
Zero nonincident candidates, zero node events without a visible exit, and exact preservation of 29695 same-tunnel multi-edge observations.
Environment, frozen inputs/tools, command, raw log, metrics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
failure_policy: Fail without changing any data, radius, offset, margin, mask, event or split when a source/tool/count drifts; a nonincident edge enters; a physical edge is collapsed; any node event has zero visible exit; C10/M-TARE is read; timeout/disk limits are exceeded; or output is nondeterministic.
